src: APPSC Group-III Panchayat Secretary Mains Paper-II 2017
s: Kalamkari in the form of painting base is practiced by artisans at?
x: Kalamkari has two styles: the Srikalahasti style is free-hand painting with a pen (kalam), while the Machilipatnam-Pedana style uses block printing. 'Painting base' therefore means Srikalahasti.

s: On which date did N.T. Rama Rao found the Telugu Desam Party?
x: NTR founded the TDP on 29 March 1982, not 29 May.
